# Fix dependency-tree.md's wave-4 NetworkPolicy AppSet list — 6 entries missing

`docs/dependency-tree.md`'s "ArgoCD apply order (sync-waves)" table, wave-4 row's
"*generated by `networkpolicy` AppSet:*" sub-list, named only 13 of the 19 elements
actually defined in `gitops/platform/networkpolicy-appset.yaml`'s
`generators[0].list.elements`. Missing: `kro-networkpolicy`, `inkless-networkpolicy`,
`istio-system-networkpolicy`, `longhorn-networkpolicy`, `harbor-networkpolicy`,
`node-exporter-networkpolicy`.

This wasn't just an omission relative to the manifest — the same document's own prose
elsewhere (the istio-system and longhorn-system per-namespace sections) already states
that `istio-system-networkpolicy` and `longhorn-networkpolicy` are "delivered by the
auto-synced ... Application (via `networkpolicy-appset.yaml`, wave 4)", contradicting
the wave-4 table row's own list, which omitted both. `harbor-networkpolicy`,
`node-exporter-networkpolicy`, `inkless-networkpolicy`, and `kro-networkpolicy` weren't
mentioned anywhere else in the document either — a pure content gap, most likely from
the doc never being updated as later PRs (harbor rewire, node-exporter fan-out, inkless,
kro) added entries to the live AppSet.

## Fix

Added all 6 missing `appName` entries to the wave-4 row's AppSet sub-list, in the same
order they appear in `networkpolicy-appset.yaml`'s element list (`kro-networkpolicy`
after `tidb-admin-networkpolicy`; `inkless-networkpolicy`, `istio-system-networkpolicy`,
`longhorn-networkpolicy`, `harbor-networkpolicy`, `node-exporter-networkpolicy` after
`vault-networkpolicy`). Doc-only change — no manifest or behavior changes; this purely
reconciles the doc's prose with the already-correct, already-live
`gitops/platform/networkpolicy-appset.yaml`.

**Blast radius on a live cluster:** none — documentation only.

`make ci` passes.
